anchor_value: source rows have no stated index, spread, or interest rate
rationale: X02 flagged PRIVATE_CREDIT rows with missing interest_rate or basis_spread. In the raw schedule, representative flagged revolver and delayed-draw rows have blank/dash cells under Index, Spread, and Interest Rate, while adjacent funded loans in the same tables carry explicit SOFR/spread/rate values. Examples include Heads Up Technologies revolver, Chilton delayed draw, Hellers delayed draw, AGS revolver, and Allworth revolver. The extracted blank rate fields therefore match the source rows; the warning is an overbroad rule-scope issue for commitment-style private credit rows whose source rate fields are not stated.
